description: Continue in an earlier workspace after the server restarted (a restart starts a new, empty workspace; the earlier files stay on disk). Without path: the recent workspaces with their titles and files. With path: later tools work in that workspace. Use it when a tool says report.json, facts.json or data files are missing although an earlier call made them. Local server only.

path.description: A workspace path or name from the list; omit to list them

name: open_workspace
title: Reopen a workspace
